Grady Charity Golf Scramble 2026

About this event

The Grady Dad's Club runs this annual scramble to raise money for our school. Bring a team or sign up as a single and we will place you in a foursome.

Date: Saturday, November 7, 2026
Shotgun start: 8:30 a.m.
Format: four-person scramble

Location: Rocky Point Golf Course, 4151 Dana Shores Dr, Tampa, FL 33634

Entry fees
Single golfer: $150
Foursome: $600

Register: https://www.golfstatus.com/tournaments/synthetic-grady-charity-golf-scramble-2026

Questions go to the Grady Dad's Club through the registration page.
